title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth bomb threat of the school year on Monday. The threat was created with artificial intelligence and came through a masked phone number, similar to earlier incidents. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a safety measure, then later returned to normal operations. The latest incident follows a pattern seen in recent threats.

Gwinnett County school police are working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to find who is responsible. They are trying to determine the source of the calls. No arrests have been made so far and no suspect has been identified. The article does not describe specific next steps beyond the ongoing investigation into the repeated threats.
